correctness.rationale: Steiner gives area pi(t^2+2mu t+mu), and support-function integration gives polar area pi E[(t+Z)^(-2)] for inradius-one regular n-gons. Differentiation gives the exact signed expectation. The variance bound sigma^2<=R^2 alpha^4/45 and the elementary tan lower bound imply mu(mu-1)/sigma^2>81/16; sup_{t>=0} t(t+R)^3/(1+t)^4<=27/16 makes the derivative strictly positive for every integer n>=3 and real t>=0. Taylor expansions of bounded Z give the stated t^-2 and fixed-t n^-2 deficits; no joint uniformity is claimed. Independently confirmed the rational auxiliary-maximum derivative identity.
